mapper.insert: INSERT INTO integration_outbox (tenant_id, provider, binding_id, workitem_id, event_type, payload_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, last_error) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{provider}, #{bindingId}, #{workitemId}, #{eventType}, #{payloadJson}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{lastError})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM integration_outbox WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM integration_outbox WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED_RETRYABLE') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW(3)) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE integration_outbox SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE integration_outbox SET status = #{status}, retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL LEAST(300, POW(2, LEAST(retry_count + 1, 9))) SECOND) WHERE id = #{id}
